title: R1: T22-S v3 small-file interval calibration with a frozen candidate family

supersedes.what_is_retained: the 65 non-drift scenarios, the four drift stress scenarios, n_files = 4/8/16, the declared generators, effect scales, the [0.925,0.975] Wilson coverage band, the 0.07 type-I threshold and the three-claim Holm family
supersedes.what_changes: a frozen candidate interval family is added and at most one adequate candidate is selected on fresh pilot seeds before confirmation

provenance.observed_before_design: the September T22-S coverage failures and the standard-error-miscalibration diagnosis were observed before this protocol was written; fresh confirmation can validate a new hypothesis, it cannot retroactively preregister the old one
provenance.no_prior_r1_protocol: this is the first R1-style calibration package; it reuses the archived pipeline through the successor_20260913 t22s module and never edits it

question: Does a small, theoretically justified candidate interval family, frozen before any new production data and selected on fresh pilot seeds under an all-scenario adequacy rule, achieve the archived [0.925,0.975] coverage band across the 65 non-drift scenarios at 4/8/16 files while keeping a coherent type-I rule at or below 0.07?

hypotheses.H1_calibration: the frozen primary candidate's 95% interval Wilson band is not entirely outside [0.925,0.975] on every non-drift scenario
hypotheses.H1t_type1: with the frozen candidate's coherent p-value and the original Holm family, P(any null claim supported) is <= 0.07 on every null scenario
hypotheses.H2_selection: the pilot either freezes exactly one adequate candidate under the predeclared all-scenario rule or freezes 'none'; 'none' is a reportable outcome and is not repaired on confirmation
hypotheses.H3_withholding: descriptive: the withholding rate is reported per scenario and per candidate; zero false positives caused by universal withholding is not success
hypotheses.H4_power: descriptive: unconditional medium-effect power is reported separately from withholding and from conditional-on-not-withheld power
hypotheses.H5_secondary: every candidate's coverage, length, bias and standard-error calibration are reported beside the archived two-stage baseline, never as a replacement for it

independent_unit: a newly simulated collection of files (one Monte-Carlo replicate), not a bootstrap draw; candidates are scored on the same replicate so comparisons are paired

estimands.primary: the equal-file mean of the per-file population contrasts (the archived estimand)
estimands.candidate_targets: candidates.py TARGET, one per candidate; the random-effects candidate targets the precision-weighted file-effect mean and any target mismatch is labelled
estimands.truth: declared in the scenario (true_mu) exactly as the archived simulator computes it; no new-generator correction is applied in this version

t_equal_file_matches_archived_t.checks: the candidate t interval reproduces the archived tidmad_endpoint.t_interval on the same per-file means

coherent_pvalue_matches_pivot.checks: the coherent two-sided p equals 2(1 - F_t(|point|/se, dof)) for a t candidate

interval_ordering.checks: every candidate satisfies lo <= point <= hi on a fixed per-file fixture

targets_documented.checks: every candidate declares a target estimand and assumptions

inference.coverage_rule: Wilson interval not entirely outside the band
inference.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni step-down over the three claims, familywise level 0.05, using the selected candidate's coherent p-value
inference.adequacy_rule: a candidate is adequate if on every non-drift pilot scenario its coverage Wilson interval is not entirely outside [0.925,0.975] and its any-null-claim type-I upper Wilson bound is <= 0.07; among adequate candidates choose the shortest median primary interval length; if none is adequate freeze 'none'
inference.simultaneous_scope: confirmation reports every candidate separately; the frozen candidate is primary and the others are secondary, with no post-hoc reselection

stopping_rule: fixed allocation: pilot 4 chunks x 8 pilot scenarios x 100 MC = 3200 replicates; confirmation 10 chunks x 69 scenarios x 100 MC = 69,000 replicates; the run stops when the enumerated cells complete

failure_interpretation.coverage_outside_tolerance: the candidate does not repair the archived miscalibration in that regime; reported as such, with the baseline beside it
failure_interpretation.none_adequate: no candidate met the all-scenario rule; the calibration is reported as a failure and R4 must not assume an interval exists
failure_interpretation.type1_above_tolerance: the coherent decision rule over-claims in that regime; any future instrument run at that regime is infeasible
failure_interpretation.control_failure: the run is not reducible (exit 4); the candidate code or the reuse of the archived pipeline is wrong
failure_interpretation.high_withholding: counted separately; conditional-on-not-withheld power is not a substitute

budget.retry_policy: a failed cell is charged and retried only by an explicit --allow-repeat; retries are never refunded

explicitly_not_claimed: any change to the archived T22-S verdicts, intervals or p-values (all withheld)
that the candidate family is exhaustive or that the selection is the only defensible rule
adequacy of any interval on unexamined instrument data
that a repaired coverage implies a coherent decision rule unless the candidate's own p is used
any analysis of the archived pulse proxy
any scientific result from fixture (development) runs
